## What the catch-all cards' skeletons accept and produce

| card | reads | input | output | type-preserving |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P01 | x | any value (the first stage reads it) | P01.STAGES[-1].out (declared) | no |
| P12 | task, x | ITEMS: a list of non-null items | P12.REDUCE() (unchecked) | no |
| P20 | x | GEN (judge): any value | {result: P20.GEN.schema, tries} or {result: null, review} | no |
| P54 | task, x | PARTS (fn): any value | P54.COMBINE() (unchecked) | no |

**P01.**
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:8` `let v = x;`: x enters unchecked: no schema is applied to it before the first stage.
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:10` `flow.call(s.hash, v,`: a call stage hands v to a child; the child contract types it (CALL_TYPE), not P01.
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:11` `judgeSpec(s.spec, prev)`: a judge stage reads only the previous value.
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:12` `flow.step(s.name, () => s.fn(v))`: a step stage is a fn:pure of v alone (slot params ["v"]): any value in, any value out.
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:13` `validates(s.out, v)`: every stage output is checked against that stage's out, a required schema slot.
- `cards/P01/skeleton.mjs:16` `return v;`: the output is the last stage's value, so it satisfies STAGES[-1].out: a declared type fixed at S6.
- `task` is not read after the signature line.

**P12.**
- `cards/P12/skeleton.mjs:5` `const items = S.ITEMS(task, x);`: ITEMS is a path accessor (assemble.mjs renderPath): a location in the task inputs or in x.
- `cards/P12/skeleton.mjs:6` `items.length <= S.MAX_ITEMS`: the location holds a list (flow.map at line 7 iterates it).
- `cards/P12/skeleton.mjs:7` `it.id ?? i`: each item is dereferenced, so a null or undefined item throws: items are non-null.
- `cards/P12/skeleton.mjs:9` `items[i].id ?? i`: the id echo dereferences each item again.
- `cards/P12/skeleton.mjs:10` `return S.REDUCE(res);`: the output is REDUCE(results), returned unchecked; REDUCE sees only [{...BODY(item), id}].

**P20.**
- `cards/P20/skeleton.mjs:8` `tries++;`: tries counts up from 0: an integer.
- `cards/P20/skeleton.mjs:9` `judgeSpec(S.GEN, { input: x, problem:`: GEN reads {input: x, problem}: any x.
- `cards/P20/skeleton.mjs:10` `problem = S.VERIFY(out, x);`: VERIFY reads (out, x); its truthy return is the problem, unchecked.
- `cards/P20/skeleton.mjs:14` `return problem ? { result: null, review: { problem, tries } } : { result: out, tries };`: two closed shapes: {result, tries} or {result: null, review: {problem, tries}}.
- `experiments/jit/flow.mjs:144` `callModel({ model, system: String(system), prompt: text, schema,`: result is a GEN judge value, requested under GEN.schema (a slot): declared, fixed at S6.
- `task` is not read after the signature line.

**P54.**
- `cards/P54/skeleton.mjs:7` `const parts = S.PARTS(task, x);`: the input is read only through PARTS, a fn:pure over (task, x): any value.
- `cards/P54/skeleton.mjs:8` `validates(S.ARG, p.input)`: what is checked is each part input against ARG, not x.
- `cards/P54/skeleton.mjs:13` `validates(S.READS, k)`: READS checks child outputs as COMBINE reads them, not the fragment output.
- `cards/P54/skeleton.mjs:14` `return S.COMBINE(kids, parts);`: the output is COMBINE(kids, parts), returned unchecked; no slot declares its schema.
